description: Permissions for the Ember webview shell. `remote` is REQUIRED: the app loads the Ember server in the webview, and a remote origin gets NO IPC access without it. allow-ember-commands (permissions/app-commands.toml) is equally required — remote origins are denied even this app's own commands unless a permission names them. `remote.urls` is rewritten at build time by scripts/set-url.mjs to list ONLY the origin EMBER_APP_URL points the window at (bughunt L3) — this checked-in value is the safe default a signed release build ships with, and must never also grant IPC to a local dev server on the user's own machine.
